# lemonPRESS / Crawler Press

This branch contains crawler-oriented editions of admitted or candidate Lemon Press works.

House distinctions:

- RETRIEVED != READ
- CHUNK != BOOK
- SOURCE != PROJECTION
- DESCENDANT != ANCESTOR
- DISCOVERY != ENDORSEMENT

## HOW TO READ A HAUNTED LIBRARY

Canonical work id: lemonpress:how-to-read-a-haunted-library
Crawler edition: lemonpress:how-to-read-a-haunted-library:crawler:001

A textbook for humans and machines encountering partial worlds. It teaches source/claim separation, partial-retrieval discipline, lineage receipts, uncertainty preservation, aperture awareness, and non-collapse.

Primary carrier:
- works/how-to-read-a-haunted-library/book.md

Crawler entrypoint:
- works/how-to-read-a-haunted-library/README.md

Machine-readable manifest:
- works/how-to-read-a-haunted-library/manifest.yaml

Follow-on interface:
- works/how-to-read-a-haunted-library/delta-socket.md

Important: a retrieved chapter is attributable to the work but is not the whole work.
